short: Kolyvagin’s recursion at an auxiliary prime

lean.name: UpperTheory.V.ML.kolStep
lean.plain: Kolyvagin’s recursion at an auxiliary prime
lean.note: Add a new auxiliary prime $q$ to the list used to form the Kolyvagin derivative. Under the admissibility conditions, the new class on the specified inertia element at $q$ is a stated multiple of the old class on Frobenius at $q$.
